id: title:DanielVisca:open the metrics alpha to self serve enrollment

observations.behavior: Adds a fallback configuration option that overrides the router's current route when determining which scene title and icon to display.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows gated or early-access products like Metrics to show their own branded header instead of inheriting an unrelated page title (e.g., Error404) while still being behind a feature flag.

observations.behavior: Defines metadata for the FeaturePreviewGate used by the Metrics product, including its specific title, description, documentation URL, and associated scene ID.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes how users see and interact with the entry point for the Metrics product before they are granted access, changing copy from private alpha to open alpha and removing waitlist language.

observations.behavior: Removes the explicit conditional rendering guard on the navigation item in the main menu, allowing it to appear regardless of whether the user has the required feature flag enabled.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the behavior of the public-facing navigation so that unauthenticated or non-flagged users can click through to a preview gate rather than having the link disappear entirely.

observations.limitations: The change relies on shared types and configuration structures without showing implementation details of those dependencies. The removal of the `flag` property could have unintended consequences if other parts of the application expect this field to control visibility; however, no such checks are shown here. No tests demonstrate end-to-end behavior after these changes except one unrelated test update. No tier 3 systemic benefit is demonstrated across multiple components or critical paths.

review.limitations: The change relies on shared types and configuration structures without showing implementation details of those dependencies. The removal of the `flag` property could have unintended consequences if other parts of the application expect this field to control visibility; however, no such checks are shown here. No tests demonstrate end-to-end behavior after these changes except one unrelated test update. No tier 3 systemic benefit is demonstrated across multiple components or critical paths.
review.reason: This chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement: adding an override mechanism for gated UI headers while simultaneously transitioning a specific product (Metrics) into open alpha by exposing its entry point. This improves discoverability and reduces dead-ends for early-access features. However, there is no evidence of broader systemic risk reduction or cross-component dependency handling sufficient for tier 3. Tier 1 would apply only if this were purely cosmetic or documentation-only; instead, it introduces new runtime behavior and removes existing guards, warranting at least tier 2.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog’s frontend architecture supporting private/alpha products and their transition to wider availability. It helps maintain consistent user experience when gating access while still allowing discovery.
review.uncertainty: The actual impact depends on whether removing the flag guard causes navigation errors elsewhere, but that cannot be determined without seeing dependent code. The change could also have unintended side effects not captured in this chunk.
